parallels.note: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

translations.web: However the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was not yet a house built for Yahweh’s name.
translations.bsb: The people, however, were still sacrificing on the high places because a house for the Name of the LORD had not yet been built.
translations.kjv: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.
translations.asv: Only the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was no house built for the name of Jehovah until those days.
